name: MyPaltan v2 - Staff Tournament Team Update

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, role, is_active FROM users WHERE id = $1

SELECT e.id, e.status, e.registered_by, e.division_id, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.organizer_user_id, tm.name AS team_name, d.name AS dname, d.max_teams, (SELECT l.slug FROM tournament_web_links l WHERE l.tournament_id = t.id LIMIT 1) AS slug, (SELECT u.phone FROM app_users u WHERE u.id = e.registered_by) AS coach_phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries x WHERE x.division_id = e.division_id AND x.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved FROM tournament_entries e JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = e.tournament_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = e.division_id WHERE e.id = $1
